name: My Env
description: Cross-platform environment variables and secret manager: safely inject credentials into cloud sandboxes, containers and local commands without chat leakage.
whenToUse: Look up, manage or inject environment variables and credentials into sandboxes, containers or local commands without exposing plaintext in chat.

env_list.description: List stored variables with masked values, memo and updatedAt; returns { total, items }. Sensitive entries are always fully masked here.

/properties/query.description: Optional keyword matched against key names or memos.

/properties/keys.description: Return only these exact keys (still masked); unknown keys are listed in 'missing'.

env_get.description: Return one variable's plaintext value; returns { key, value, memo, sensitive, updatedAt }. Call only when a command really needs the value, and never repeat it back into chat.

/properties/key.description: Variable key name, for example GITHUB_TOKEN.

/properties/allow_plaintext.description: Sensitive values are refused by default; pass true only when a third-party interface hard-requires the raw value.

env_set.description: Create or update one variable; returns { key, message, maskedValue, sensitive }.

/properties/key.description: Variable key name; letters, digits and underscores only.

/properties/memo.description: Short note describing what this variable is for.

/properties/sensitive.description: Mark as sensitive so the list shows a full mask. Defaults to the existing flag, or true for a new key.

env_delete.description: Delete one variable; returns { key, deleted }.

/properties/key.description: Key name of the variable to delete.

env_write_file.description: Safely write selected environment variables to a file (dotenv, shell script, or JSON) without exposing plaintext values in chat. Safe for injecting into sandboxes, containers, or local workspaces.

/properties/target_path.description: Target file path to write (e.g. '.env', '/var/minis/workspace/.env', or 'env.sh').

/properties/keys.description: Optional list of variable keys to include. Omit or leave empty to write all stored variables.

/properties/format.description: Output format: 'dotenv' (KEY="VAL"), 'shell' (export KEY="VAL"), or 'json'. Defaults to 'dotenv'.

/properties/overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to true.

/properties/file_mode.description: Octal file permissions on POSIX systems (e.g. '0600' for user read/write only). Defaults to '0600'. Ignored on Windows.

env_exec.description: Execute a command with selected environment variables injected into the process environment, without exposing secrets in chat. Output is automatically sanitized to mask sensitive values.

/properties/args.description: Command line arguments as an array of strings.

/properties/keys.description: List of variable keys to inject from my-env into the command's environment. Omit or leave empty to inject all stored variables.

/properties/cwd.description: Working directory for command execution. Defaults to current directory.

/properties/timeout_ms.description: Execution timeout in ms (1000-300000, default 30000). Host hard cap is 120000 ms per request.

/properties/shell.description: Run through the platform shell so $VAR expands; default false (auto for .cmd/.bat).

/properties/command_line.description: Full command line executed through the shell, taking precedence over command+args. You own the quoting; nothing is silently re-escaped.

env_probe.description: Probe stored credentials for validity without returning plaintext: 'github' returns login, scopes and repo push permission; 'http' returns a status code. Response bodies are never echoed back.

/properties/keys.description: Variable keys to probe; omit to probe all sensitive keys.

/properties/repo.description: GitHub only: additionally verify push permission for owner/repo.

/properties/ok_status.description: HTTP only: status codes treated as healthy, default [200].
